name: notify-is-open-end-with-nothing-awaited
description: A notify is exactly one open carrying end and nothing else: no handle, no awaited result, no second frame in either direction (WSM-API-005). The two expect_no_frame steps are the assertion that matters. A notify implemented as a request whose result is discarded would look identical on the opener's first frame and differ on everything after it - and the receiver must not answer it either, which is what makes the third matcher worth writing.
